front.title: Dealing with LLMs in IETF Discussions

abstract.t: The rapid adoption of AI language tools has prompted concern across professional and technical communities, including the IETF, about authenticity, accountability, and the integrity of human contribution. This document approaches the question from two directions: a critical reader's concerns about what AI use means for IETF discussion, and a practitioner's account of how AI is currently being used in IETF discussions. We aim to explore some of the issues arising, and perhaps make some specific (but tentative) recommendations, but the main recommendation is that the IETF should develop guidelines for use of AI tooling when engaging in IETF discussions.
